meaning:
παρ-αινέω, -ω
[in LXX: 2Ma.7:25-26, 3Ma.5:17 3Mac 7:12 * ;]
to exhort, advise: with accusative of person(s) and inf. (see Bl., § 72, 5; M, Pr., 205), Act.27:22; absol., before λέγων, Act.27:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous, because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them
